title: Negative reactive-slope inertia forces two residues and an upper in-band pole
statement: In the fixed bare reciprocal waveguide response at E0=1.5B, both reactive slope eigenvalues are negative. Cancelling the whole slope requires at least two independent positive rank-one passive residues. Odd-channel derivative cancellation also forces some pole in(E0,2B); arbitrary frequency-dependent controllers and other bath envelopes are outside this obstruction.

In source B=1 units, odd derivative moments require sum r/d^2=t_minus and sum r/d^3=u_minus, with u_minus-2*t_minus>14.3839. If each pole is below E0 or above the bath edge2, the cubic moment is<=2 times the quadratic moment, a contradiction. No pole at E0 is allowed. Rank counts independent coupling columns, not merely named cavities.
